description: OpenCred Server — critical-path latency from OpenTelemetry traces. Filters by `service.name = opencred-server`. Pair with Tempo or Jaeger as the trace data source. Source: nfh-trust-labs/opencred#581 (scale Tier 3 #10).

panels.title: HTTP server p50/p95/p99
panels.description: Latency of every HTTP request, grouped by route pattern. Sourced from `http.server` spans emitted by tracingMiddleware. The route pattern (e.g. `POST /credentials/batch/:jobId/cancel`) is the canonical operator-facing name — never raw URLs.

panels.title: batch.row.process duration distribution
panels.description: Per-row processing time. Grouped by `batch.proof_format` so vc-jwt / data-integrity / sd-jwt-vc costs are visible separately. Drill in by `batch.job_id` (opaque UUID) to chase a slow batch.

panels.title: signer.sign duration by algorithm + kind
panels.description: Time spent inside Signer.sign(). The `signer.kind` attribute distinguishes software / pkcs11 / os-cert / cloud-hsm-{aws,azure,gcp}. Signature buffers are NEVER recorded — only metadata.

panels.title: verify.credential outcomes
panels.description: Verification result codes (`verify.code`) over time. Spikes in INVALID / UNRESOLVABLE signal a verifier-side incident; spikes in REVOKED signal a real revocation event.

panels.title: verify.did_resolve latency by DID method
panels.description: Time spent resolving issuer DIDs. did:web is network-bound and will dominate p99; did:key is offline and should sit near the noise floor.

panels.title: DeDi adapter latency
panels.description: DeDi lookup / publish / update durations, grouped by registry (`dedi.registry`). `dedi.host` is recorded but path is NOT (see CLAUDE.md — record names can carry credential identifiers).

panels.title: Errors by span name
panels.description: Spans that closed with `status.code=ERROR`. A spike here means recordException fired somewhere in the critical path — pivot to the trace view to find the offender.

title: OpenCred Server — Critical-Path Overview
